correctness.rationale: For n>=4 periodic two-leg square ladder with degree-three sites and the exact two-end vacancy Kob–Andersen hop rule, each quadruple (a,b,c,d) passes a local Boolean test iff its central rung and two following leg edges disallow enabled hopping. Independently rebuilt the 64 triple-rung transfer states, counted 108 allowed weighted transitions and identified a single 29-state primitive recurrent class. Independently constructed its exact symbolic characteristic polynomial, verifying x^16 F(x,z)G(x,z) with given octic/quintic, and separately brute-enumerated all rung words n=4..8 and full particle-size distribution with totals 54,129,319,837,2150. The exact trace/log determinant identity yields all-n polynomial Z_n; Perron-Frobenius, Rouché bound on quintic, Descartes root uniqueness for octic x>2 and analytic perturbation prove asymptotic entropy log(2.605506658540588...) per rung and density 0.736222013311... per site. These are all-n analytic consequences of the verified transfer identity.
